# Official OpenOximetry documents retrieved (public links, no login) on 2026-10-07
Retrieved with plain HTTP GET of publicly shared links published on openoximetry.org. SHA-256 in `official_docs_sha256.txt`.
| File (official_docs/) | Source |
|---|---|
| dict_gid_0_fields.csv | Data dictionary, sheet "Fields" (Google Sheet linked from https://openoximetry.org/data-repository/, sheet id 16NjoxOZ_CGlmKmNjZAxyJRH1DshJ2f-XLPq-Uh1Nib4, gid 0) |
| dict_gid_1203162302.csv (= data_dictionary_gsheet.csv) | same sheet, tab "Tables" |
| dict_gid_419989003.csv | same sheet, tab "Waveform" |
| lab_protocol.txt | Laboratory-based, controlled hypoxemia pulse oximeter human study protocol (UCSF Hypoxia Lab), linked from https://openoximetry.org/study-protocols/ |
| skin_protocol.txt | Skin color quantification protocol (UCSF Hypoxia Lab, March 2025), same page |
| cm700d_sop.txt | UCSF Hypoxia Lab Konica Minolta CM700d SOP |
| ppg_howto.txt | How to capture raw PPG signal |
| repo_terms.txt | OpenOximetry Project Data Repository Data Sharing Terms (2023-08-06) |
| doc_1XGX.txt, doc_1yMc.txt | other protocol documents linked from the site (not used for conclusions) |
| p_*.html, gs_view.html | the web pages the links were taken from |
Caveats: the dictionary is a live Google Sheet (unversioned; it types device ids as int although the v1.1.1 files use float ids, so it predates v1.1.1 in at least that respect). The study protocol describes laboratory practice; it is not a description of how the CSV rows were built.
